scope_note: Discovery-only dictionary for all 42,720 canonical works (data/catalog/works, snapshot 2026-09-14), not evidence of use, deployment, training, inference, device counts, or market share. Matches require independent source review. Categories reuse the nine equipment categories. family_only preserves unknown generation/configuration; no capacity, interface, board vendor, EDU tier, real-vs-simulated setting, or component expansion is inferred. ALOHA is a system, not a synonym for its arms. hardware_ids link existing reported identities for discovery and do not merge or rewrite authority records; the RTX 4090 link points to a reported composite workstation. Short or ambiguous aliases require local context_terms, token boundaries, and longest-specific-match precedence. Generic robot/PC/sensor descriptions, bare vendor-only names, motors, simulators, software, datasets, and policy/VLA names are excluded.
